h: Kylian Mbappé responds after losing the 2026 Ballon d'Or to Harry Kane
p: Kylian Mbappé has reportedly reacted to missing out on the 2026 Ballon d'Or, which went to England captain Harry Kane. The France forward finished behind Kane in the voting at the London ceremony. His response has drawn plenty of attention from football fans online.
more: Kane became the first Englishman to win the award in 25 years.
Lamine Yamal was also among the leading names in the voting.
The organisers earlier apologised after the winners were published by mistake.
